subject: Request: short holdover extension while PO clears - Novamed
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Welcome + 14-day trial access for Novamed

Elena — great meeting today. Per our demo, I’ve enabled a 14-day trial for the team (sandbox cluster + 20k tokens worth of credits) so you can validate the integration pain points you showed.

Next steps I proposed:
- UX team to run 3 canonical prompts on the sandbox by 11/22
- Procurement to confirm purchase order by 11/30 (internal timeline you shared)

If procurement needs a formal invoice / PO template or a quick procurement call, loop Adam from your side and I’ll pull in our procurement specialist.

Attachments: trial-credit-request-form.pdf (PDF) — I filled in the trial parameters we discussed.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Welcome + 14-day trial access for Novamed

Ben — really appreciate the quick setup and demo. Quick update from our side: procurement is blocking until we get a copy of the SOW and legal reviewed the commercial terms.

Realistically PO will be delayed beyond 11/30 — likely into early December. Can Redwood provide a short holdover extension or interim credits so our engineering team can finish the integration tests? If we lose the sandbox access now we’ll have to re-schedule the UX time which would push everything out.

Cc'd Adam Chen (procurement) so he has context.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Product Ops
Novamed
elena.ramos@novamed.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Welcome + 14-day trial access for Novamed

Elena — thanks for the heads up. We want to avoid interrupting your validation window. Two asks from our side while we try to approve this:

1) Can you confirm the specific dates you need the holdover for (range or end date)?
2) Any compliance artifacts procurement needs immediately (SOC 2 scope, retention policy snippet) — I can drop those now.

Internally I’m requesting a short interim credit allocation for Novamed to bridge until the PO clears. Monica — I’ve attached the trial form; can you advise on standard holdover limits (we typically do a one-week extension or up to 25k tokens depending on usage). Karthik — please confirm if we can approve this at AE level or if FP&A/Revenue Ops sign-off is required given the region/deal size.

Ben
